findings.summary: IC power pin U2.1 (VIN) has no DC path to a power rail (net 'SYS_RAW')
findings.description: Pin U2.1 (VIN) is type=power_in on net 'SYS_RAW'. Graph walk (≤2 hops, rejecting capacitor edges, accepting resistors≤1Ω, inductors, ferrite beads, bridged solder jumpers) did not reach a named power rail. The pin is likely AC-coupled to ground only — the IC will not power up reliably.
findings.recommendation: Verify the schematic for this pin: the DC route must go through a conducting element (direct wire, 0Ω resistor, inductor, ferrite bead, or bridged solder jumper) — not a capacitor. If the intent was to tie VCC through an LC filter, add the missing inductor or 0Ω in series.
